feedback.worked_solution:
Using the method of polynomial division, we obtain the following:

$$
\begin{aligned} & \,\,\,\,\,-7x+4 \\  & 2{x}^{2}-5x+3\,\enclose{longdiv}{\,\,-14{x}^{3}+43{x}^{2}-50x+17\,\,} \\  & \,\,\,\,\,{\,\,-14{x}^{3}+35{x}^{2}-21x}_{―} \\  & \,\,\,\,\,8{x}^{2}-29x+17 \\  & \,\,\,\,\,{8{x}^{2}-20x+12}_{―} \\  & \,\,\,\,\,-9x+5\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore,

- the quotient is $-7x+4,$ and

- the remainder is $-9x+5.$
